symptom.statement: The profile updater blocks every change to a profile already at the structural ceiling (15/15): the before/after proof returns NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT and no consumer accepts it.

immediate_cause.statement: compare() emits EVOLUTION_DEMONSTRATED only when at least one dimension flips from fail to pass; with base score == required no dimension can flip, so the verdict is NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT and the proof workflow job exits 1.

systemic_root_cause.statement: The proof contract defines acceptable evidence as 'demonstrated structural improvement' and encodes that single positive verdict in three independent consumers (compare exit code, workflow predicate, edge verifier). Non-regression at the ceiling has no verdict of its own, so the contract is unsatisfiable by construction once base == required, regardless of the quality or intent of the change.

causal_chain.statement: The baseline evaluator reports NO_UPDATE_REQUIRED when all 15 dimensions pass.

A governed change to that profile still reaches compare(); improved is empty because no dimension can flip, and the tool sets verdict NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT while structural_ceiling_reached is true.
The workflow requires verdict == EVOLUTION_DEMONSTRATED and the edge verifier rejects anything else with PROOF_COMPARISON_NOT_DEMONSTRATED, so the update step cannot be recorded.

first_bad_control.statement: compare() collapses 'no regression' and 'no improvement' into a verdict that no consumer accepts; the ceiling is detected (structural_ceiling_reached) but not turned into an acceptable outcome.

escape_control.statement: The structural_ceiling_reached flag exists in the proof but nothing reads it; the three consumers each re-implement 'verdict == EVOLUTION_DEMONSTRATED' instead of consuming a single acceptance decision.

recurrence_evidence.fact: The repository test test_ceiling_flag_when_base_is_already_complete asserts the blocking verdict at the ceiling, so the behavior is encoded as expected.
recurrence_evidence.scope: compare tool unit test at commit 288c97c8

recurrence_evidence.fact: Re-running compare() with an evaluator at 15/15 and a changed candidate returned NO_DEMONSTRATED_IMPROVEMENT, improved=[], regressed=[], structural_ceiling_reached=true (proof_sha256 ccba0480...).

invariant.statement: A profile update proof is acceptable only if it shows structural improvement, or shows exact non-regression with base and candidate both at the structural ceiling; any regression or sub-ceiling no-improvement is never acceptable.

hard_guard.control: Single acceptance decision computed by the trusted compare() tool and consumed unchanged by the workflow and the edge verifier.
hard_guard.fail_closed_condition: Block unless verdict is EVOLUTION_DEMONSTRATED, or NON_REGRESSION_AT_CEILING with candidate_score == required == base_score, improved == [] and regressed == [].
hard_guard.observable_result: No update step is recorded and the annotation carries the rejecting verdict and codes.
